video_title: Kanye Took Jeezy’s Record and Made “Can’t Tell Me Nothing”

quotes.speaker: Jeezy
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeezy on Kanye West's creative process for 'Can't Tell Me Nothing'
quotes.excerpt: Kanye West put on feature was crazy because I remember that he wasn't doing any records
quotes.quote: I think Kanye West put on feature was crazy because I remember that he wasn't doing any records because his mom had passed and he wasn't doing any records and I hit him up and it was crazy because he did a record for me on The Recession and he changed the beat. The name of the song was I Got Money. That was my song. He changed the beat and changed the song. So when he sent it back, I was like, Kanye, these are two different records. So he kept the record and then he called me six months later, it was, you can't tell me nothing. But that was my record.

quotes.speaker: Jeezy
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeezy on collaborating with Kanye West on 'Put On'
quotes.excerpt: I sent it to him. I got on my tour bus because I was headed out. He called me like 10 minutes later rapping the verse.
quotes.quote: I explained to him what Put On meant. He said, send it. I sent it to him. I got on my tour bus because I was headed out. He called me like 10 minutes later rapping the verse. You know what I'm saying? He had the whole, I was like, go lay it down. He said, I already did. I was like, send it to me. He sent it to me and I sent it straight to LA Reid. I was like, I got my single.

quotes.speaker: Jeezy
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeezy on the collaborative effort behind 'Love in This Club'
quotes.excerpt: doing the record with Usher with Love in This Club, shout out to Polo, because Polo really made that happen.
quotes.quote: I would definitely say doing the record with Usher with Love in This Club, shout out to Polo, because Polo really made that happen. They were trying to put a lot of people on that record. And Polo called me one day and he was like, listen to the radio tomorrow. He just put it out the way it was and it went. And I remember, shout out to Polo the Don.

quotes.speaker: Jeezy
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeezy and Stephen Jackson on the impact of 'Seen It All'
quotes.excerpt: After that verse on Seen It All, I know you walked out that booth like, hold on, hoe.

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen Jackson
text_blocks.text: But you had to be in some type, you had to feel like MJ walking out that booth after doing Seen It All. After that verse on Seen It All, I know you walked out that booth like, hold on, hoe.

text_blocks.speaker: Jeezy
text_blocks.text: I'm going to be honest with you though, because you know the homies in the studio like, he got you on the last one. I was like, you think? That Seen It All was one of the ones, man. It was one of the ones and we didn't even do that in the studio together. I sent it to him. I called him, I was like, yo, I got this record. And he said, yo, he said, send it. And I sent it to him. He hit me back like two days later, he was like, check your mail. And I pressed play and I was like, you know what I'm saying?

quotes.speaker: Jeezy
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeezy on the Andre 3000 collaboration for 'I Do'
quotes.excerpt: when I heard the verse, I had to live with it for a minute but I was like, it's probably one of the best verses on hip hop ever.
quotes.quote: When I heard the verse, I had to live with it for a minute but I was like, it's probably one of the best verses on hip hop ever. And that was with me and Hove and Andre 3000 did I Do. Andre 3000 verse on I Do was crazy. Oh my god, that is crazy.
